messages:
marta: FYI CI is red on the /guides SDK page, linkcheck failing with giant block of code showing up in the rendered HTML.

alex: saw that, reproducing locally. it looks like our mdx-snippet extractor left CRLFs in the embedded snippet, which makes the fenced codeblocks not terminate in the final mdx.

jamie: ohhh. so the rest of the page is treated as code and anchors disappear -> linkcheck throws 404s. nice catch. :face_with_monocle:

marta: minimal repro: the snippet file has windows line endings. extractor outputs:```
```javascript
import {Client}from '@redwood/inference'\r\nconst c = new Client()\r\nawait c.generate({ prompt: 'hi' })\r\n```
notice the trailing CRs.

alex: yep. docusaurus/mdx doesn't care about CRLF inside fenced blocks when the fence itself is followed by CRLF, but our post-process step strips only LF, so the closing fence becomes "```\r" in the compiled mdx and isn't recognized.

jamie: quick hack: run `dos2unix` over snippets before bundling in the CI job. I can add a step in the docs-build workflow.

marta: can you add that and a short unit check in the extractor to normalize line endings? this has been popping up intermittently.

alex: opening PR with both: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4214 — adds `find docs/snippets -type f -exec dos2unix {} +` to the build matrix and a python check in `scripts/extract_snippets.py` that calls `content.replace('\r\n', '\n')`.

ci-bot: build #3124 failed on linkcheck. rerun triggered by alex.

docs-bot: note: linkcheck plugin treats missing anchors as errors; once mdx compiles correctly the anchors reappear.

jamie: tested alex's branch locally by running `npm run build:docs` -> build passes, linkcheck no longer reports the anchor errors. :white_check_mark:

marta: nice. can we also add a quick grep to the CI step to fail early if any snippet file contains CR (e.g., `grep -I $'\r' -R docs/snippets || true`) so authors get faster feedback?

alex: added that to the PR too. it's a non-blocking check that prints a warning and the fixer command. optionally we can make it block after one week.

jamie: pinging owners of recent snippet PRs: @sam (recent snippet PR), @leena. please pull & rebase if you edited snippet files on windows.

marta: I'll merge once CI is green. leaving a follow-up TODO to audit content pipeline for other newline/encoding gotchas (BOMs, non-utf8).

alex: thanks — will add an issue for BOM detection.

ci-bot: build #3124 rerun succeeded. merge allowed.

marta: merged. leaving this thread open for a couple hours in case of fallout. :thumbsup:

jamie: retrospective note: snippet extraction should always normalize to LF and strip BOMs. adding to docs runbook.

marta: closing once the canary site finishes deploy.

docs-bot: canary site deploy complete, no regressions detected.

marta: closing now — thanks everyone.
